label: Slack
description: Slack bot, user, and app-level tokens.
title: Slack token

signals.reason: A bot token (xoxb-) reads and posts messages with the scopes of its app. A sent message can be deleted, but people may have read it. Its scopes come from the app settings, so Apassy does not suggest the scope.
A user token (xoxp-) acts as a person, with the scopes that the person granted. Apassy does not suggest the scope.
An app-level token (xapp-) opens Socket Mode connections for its app. It works together with a bot or user token of the app.
The item name or a label names Slack.
A host of the item is a Slack host.
